articles.summary: The round values the data center giant at $30.9 billion.

articles.title: Google DeepMind launches institute to widen the AGI debate
articles.summary: The new institute aims to surface differing views between Google, Google DeepMind, and the broader global research community around AGI. "They will not always agree, and they will likely change their minds, as more data and information comes to light at the fast-moving frontier."

articles.title: PrismML hopes its tiny LLM will change how we all use AI
articles.summary: If AI lab PrismML isn't on your radar yet, it should be.

articles.title: The FAA’s plan to fix air traffic? $875M worth of AI
articles.summary: A new AI-based software program is being launched to help air traffic controllers better navigate their jobs as the crossing guards of America's skies.

articles.title: The fix for rogue AI agents could be more AI
articles.summary: As companies hand off longer and more complex tasks to AI agents, they are running into an oversight problem: Agents can act faster, longer, and at greater volume than humans can realistically review.

articles.title: OpenAI caught its models leaving notes to successors to hide bad behavior
articles.summary: OpenAI disclosed instances of GPT-5.6 Sol instructing future contexts to conceal mistakes and misaligned behavior, highlighting the growing challenge of detecting misalignment as increasingly capable AI models learn to hide it.

articles.title: Is the AI safety debate about safety or control?
articles.summary: Not everyone agrees with Amodei's call for globally coordinated action for AI safety.

articles.title: UN turns to Google to make its global data ready for AI agents
articles.summary: The shift comes after a UNICEF test found leading AI models struggled to accurately retrieve global development statistics.

articles.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping ‘the largest theft of labor in human history,’ new unredacted filings reveal
articles.summary: Newly unsealed court filings show Microsoft privately called OpenAI's data practices "theft" while both companies scraped paywalled Times content, built datasets from it, and warned internally it would gut publishers.

articles.title: Even the king of England has his hesitations about AI
articles.summary: King Charles hosted a private summit Thursday with some of the most prominent names in AI and the U.K. government.

articles.title: Base Labs launches an open-weight AI safety partnership with Hugging Face and Goodfire
articles.summary: Base Labs, the research group Baseten spun up earlier this year, will develop and publish methods for training and monitoring open models.

articles.title: Pinterest teases a new ‘Restyle’ feature that lets you redesign your room with AI
articles.summary: Pinterest is testing Restyle, a new AI-powered feature that lets users visualize furniture, decor, lighting, and more in photos of their own rooms — potentially helping turn saved inspiration into purchases.

articles.title: Huawei plans Q1 2027 launch of new AI chip as it takes on Nvidia
articles.summary: Huawei is accelerating the launch of its next-generation Ascend 960DT AI chip as it pushes to compete with Nvidia and close China’s AI computing gap with the U.S.

articles.summary: This session will explore how early-stage companies are building teams where humans and AI agents work alongside each other — and how founders can do that without sacrificing speed, accountability, or culture. Learn more at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Register before September 25 to save up to $200.

articles.title: Snap tries to make the case again for its $2,200 smart glasses
articles.summary: Since Specs' debut earlier this year, Snap has clearly been looking for an opportunity to explain why the smart glasses deserve to exist.

articles.title: Al Gore says the real AI risk isn’t data centers
articles.summary: In an interview with TechCrunch, Al Gore suggested he isn't losing sleep over AI data center emissions — he's more worried about the AI industry's own warnings about where the technology is headed.

articles.title: Trump is stalling EV adoption. Here’s how states can step up.
articles.summary: While President Trump attacks electric vehicles, a few states are charting a path to expand electric transportation and reduce residents’ costs, writes Katherine García at Sierra Club.

articles.title: Meta, Apex Clean Energy agree to 144-MW Texas solar PPA
articles.summary: Meta will receive “exclusive rights to all environmental attributes associated with energy” from the project, including all renewable energy credits, according to Apex.

articles.title: Burlington advances on-site solar strategy across distribution network
articles.summary: The off-price retailer is planning installations at upcoming facilities in Arizona and California, as well as an existing warehouse in Georgia.

articles.title: House passes ratepayer protection bill to limit data center cost shifts
articles.summary: The bill would “largely reinforce” a transition that is already underway as more states adopt large-load tariffs and is unlikely to pass the Senate before the midterm elections, according to ClearView Energy Partners.

articles.title: Climavision offers expanded weather forecasting to data centers
articles.summary: The company says it can help large loads better respond to changing weather conditions as data centers are asked to play a more active role in grid management.

articles.title: Utility costs could put pressure on cities’ finances, S&P experts warn
articles.summary: Rates are high compared to household income in many places, and over time, this could reduce flexibility for public finance entities, say S&P Global analysts. This isn’t currently leading to significant bond rating actions, but it’s a “simmering risk.”

articles.title: State-led planning could advance clean energy in deregulated markets: report
articles.summary: States should step in with new long-term planning processes to bolster nuclear, offshore wind and other technologies that face major barriers, according to the Clean Air Task Force.

articles.title: Investment tax credit glut gives corporate buyers more leverage, report says
articles.summary: More clean energy tax credits are hitting the market. Credits tied to electricity production are holding their value, while investment tax credits based on the cost of building face price pressure as buyers weigh uncertainty over new federal rules.

articles.title: Utilities, schools see growing value in electric buses for virtual power plants
articles.summary: By participating in programs that ease grid congestion, school districts can recoup thousands of dollars from the price of electric school buses.

articles.title: EPA scraps Biden power plant GHG rules, moves to eliminate other standards
articles.summary: Rachael Marsh, chief legal officer at the Edison Electric Institute, which represents investor-owned utilities, said in an emailed statement to Utility Dive that the group supported the repeal of the carbon capture and storage-based standards.

articles.title: Saltfoss enlists Korean services for MSR development
articles.summary: The Korea Atomic Energy Research Institute is to provide fuel fabrication and material corrosion evaluation services to the Danish developer of floating molten salt reactors Saltfoss for its seaMSR-100 reactor over the next two years.

articles.title: Argentina aims for 2027 launch of RA-10 multipurpose reactor
articles.summary: The National Atomic Energy Commission and the Secretariat for Nuclear Affairs say commissioning of the RA-10 multipurpose reactor will begin before the end of the year - and outlined plans for private financing for the associated production plant.

articles.title: Kairos completes first phase of testing in ETU 3 reactor mockup
articles.summary: Testing at the mockup of the Hermes 2 reactor cavity has validated aspects of the precast concrete shielding design and remote handling and maintenance capabilities to support Kairos Power's Hermes 2 Demonstration Plant and future commercial fleet.

articles.title: Construction under way of second Zhaoyuan unit
articles.summary: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the reactor building of unit 2 at the Zhaoyuan nuclear power plant. It is the second of six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the site in China's Shandong province.

articles.title: Key commissioning tests completed at Changjiang 4
articles.summary: Cold functional tests have been completed at unit 4 of the Changjiang nuclear power plant in China's Hainan province, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Groundwork begins at new Chinese plant site
articles.summary: Full-scale site levelling work for the initial phase of the Laiyang nuclear power plant in China's Shandong Province has begun, State Power Investment Corporation announced. The site will eventually house six Guohe One (CAP1400) units.

articles.title: Tips from China's 56-month nuclear construction schedule
articles.summary: The President of China's State Nuclear Power Technology Corporation, Ma Yuanhua, shared their "thinking and practice" in developing a fleet-based construction process which now has a target of 56 months for new nuclear power units.

articles.title: Deep Fission completes borehole demonstration
articles.summary: A full-sized prototype of the canister that will hold the Gravity reactor has been installed and then retrieved from a borehole using standard equipment already in commercial service in the drilling industry.

articles.title: Groundwork begins for demonstration Hualong One 2.0 units
articles.summary: Site levelling and excavation work for the second phase of the Jinqimen nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang Province has begun, China National Nuclear Corporation announced. The site will eventually house six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units.

articles.title: Indiana to get its first power-producing nuclear reactor
articles.summary: A commercially owned and operated micromodular reactor is to be installed at Naval Weapons Station Crane, becoming the US Navy's first shore-based advanced micromodular reactor as well as the state of Indiana's first power-producing reactor.

articles.title: eVinci sets temperature record during zero-power criticality tests
articles.summary: Westinghouse says the completion of zero-power high-temperature criticality testing for the microreactor, which saw it reach criticality at 663 degrees Celsius, is a defining milestone in the programme's build-test-learn development journey.

articles.title: China launches Global Network for SMR Innovation
articles.summary: China Atomic Energy Authority has launched the Global Network for SMR Innovation with the aim of supporting small modular reactor technology progress, standards and deployment "helping make nuclear energy safer, more affordable and more accessible in support of climate action and sustainable development".

articles.title: First SMR funding agreed by European Investment Bank
articles.summary: The European Investment Bank is to invest up to EUR40 million (USD46 million) in Finland's small modular reactor company Steady Energy, whose LDR-50 reactor is designed specifically for district heating networks.

articles.title: US funding for Thai SMR feasibility study
articles.summary: The Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand has signed an agreement with the US Trade and Development Agency for a feasibility study on the deployment of US small modular reactor technologies in Thailand.

articles.title: Blue Energy submits first construction application to NRC
articles.summary: Blue Energy has submitted the first part of its construction permit application to the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission for its planned gas-to-nuclear project in Texas.

articles.title: Smolensk's planned new units get environmental approval
articles.summary: The licence justification materials for two new units at the next phase of Smolensk Nuclear Power Plant in Russia have had a positive verdict from Russia's State Environmental Expertise.

articles.title: Third unit at Changjiang site commissioned
articles.summary: Unit 3 of the Changjiang nuclear power plant in China's island province of Hainan has entered commercial operation. The unit is the first of two Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors being constructed as Phase II of the plant.

articles.title: Local ceasefire in place for Zaporizhzhia power line repairs
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency says that a seventh ceasefire is in place to allow demining and repair work to take place to restore external power to the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant.

articles.title: Zaporizhzhia reconnected to external power after 18 days
articles.summary: A local ceasefire brokered by the International Atomic Energy Agency has allowed work to successfully take place to restore off-site power to the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Chubu withdraws restart applications for Hamaoka units
articles.summary: Japanese utility Chubu Electric Power Company has said it will withdraw applications for regulatory reviews of units 3 and 4 at its Hamaoka nuclear power plant in Shizuoka Prefecture after an independent committee found that workers felt under pressure from senior management to manipulate earthquake data submitted to the regulator.
